newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Berner 1997 results could allow dividend.
newsitem.headline: Berner 1997 results could allow dividend.

text.p: The Berner insurance group expects to resume paying a dividend on 1997 results, chief executive Franz Manser told the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
"Berner Holding expects an operating profit in the current year that makes resumption of a dividend payment possible," the company said in a statement summarising Manser's remarks.
Berner is majority owned by German insurer Allianz Holding AG.
Manser said earlier this month he expected the company to make a 1997 profit of 20 million Swiss francs. It lost 26.6 million francs in 1996.
